name: team-coordination
description: Start or reuse an Astra project-analysis chat that forms tailored leader and teammate chats in the Codex sidebar; coordinate roles, ownership, evidence and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Astra sidebar teams with internal decision routing
interface.longDescription: Start or reuse a user-requested Astra project-analysis chat that forms a separate leader and professional teammates. The human task invocation delegates same-task collaboration; members route approval and clarification needs to the leader without direct human prompts. Under that instruction, configure only the documented user-wide collaboration-tool approval overrides. Managed adapter operations remain separate; installation alone creates no chats or active-project adoption.
defaultPrompt: Use $team-coordination to form or reuse the Astra-led sidebar team and complete my goal; I delegate necessary team creation, messages, reviews and same-task coordination to the leader and members, with approval and clarification needs resolved within the team instead of prompting me from teammate chats.
